a/war.say: A thousand years back, six peoples fought a war nobody could end.
a/war.transcript: A thousand years back, six peoples fought a war nobody could end.

a/king.say: A farm boy ended it. So they made him king.
a/king.transcript: A farm boy ended it, so they made him king

a/roads.say: He joined every city with roads of light. Nobody went cold or hungry.
a/roads.transcript: He joined every city with roads of light. Nobody went cold or hungry

a/sickness.say: Then came a sickness no light could cure.
a/sickness.transcript: Then came a sickness no light could cure

a/night.say: So he took his people up to heaven. Every one of them, in a single night.
a/night.transcript: So he took his people up to heaven, every one of them in a single night

a/gods.say: The old gods of the land lay down to sleep until he comes home.
a/gods.transcript: The old gods of the land lay down to sleep until he comes home

a/mark.say: And one day a hand will bear the Mark, and wake them. So the priests say.
a/mark.transcript: And one day a hand will bear the mark and wake them, so the priests say

a/wall.say: [softly] That one? Damp got at it, I expect. Bed, Button.
a/wall.transcript: That one? Damp got at it, I expect. Bed button

a/doorstep.say: [softly] You came to us in the rain, with a key round your neck.
a/doorstep.transcript: You came to us in the rain with a key 'round your neck
